ops.loadingHours: The reserved time includes setup and teardown, and the venue opens 30 minutes before the reserved time on the day. Arrange with the carrier for packages to arrive within the reserved time; they are accepted from the day before. If a vendor you have engaged will decorate the venue or similar, notify the hotel in advance by phone (03-5216-8819). Loading and unloading of decorations and equipment, and the size, mounting method and location of signs, follow the rules the hotel explains to vendors.
ops.parking: The parking lot has 103 spaces; the basic fee is 400 yen per 20 minutes (standard cars). The mechanical parking for standard cars accepts vehicles up to 1.55 m high, 1.90 m wide, 5.3 m long and 2.3 t. For meeting room and banquet hall use, 2 spaces for the organizer are free; request them when booking. Buses (groups only, reservation required) can park in the bus yard; for overnight stays, medium and large buses cost 5,000 yen per night. If the lot is full, use nearby coin parking.
ops.waitingRooms: The 3F Cosmos Hall has a waiting room (31㎡, ceiling height 2.8 m). The 5F Kiku (47㎡) is a reception room for up to 8 people, and Sakura and Ran (47㎡ each) are also introduced as available for use as waiting rooms. The 6F 602 and 7F 702 (33㎡ each) can also be used as waiting rooms. Waiting room fees: full day 36,300 yen / one day 24,200 yen / 3 hours 18,150 yen / extra hour 6,050 yen (price list 2025.4, tax and service charge included).
ops.catering: Bringing in food and drink is prohibited under the Meeting, Banquet and Event Terms. Decorations, flowers, signs and special equipment are arranged by the hotel's designated vendors; to use a vendor other than the designated ones, prior approval from the hotel is required (dated April 1, 2019). For banquet cuisine, an example course is 9,680 yen and an example buffet is 7,260 yen (tax and service charge included). When the banquet food cost is 7,260 yen or more, the room fee is the "banquet room fee (2 hours)"; when it is under 7,260 yen, the 3-hour rate applies.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Restaurant IRIS (lobby floor, 80 seats), Japanese Restaurant BAIRIN (1F, 127 seats, including 40 seats in private rooms) and LOUNGE (lobby floor, 57 seats). The official site says they can also be used for after-parties and networking gatherings. BAIRIN's private rooms are Yuki-no-Ma and the Western-style private rooms for 2 to 8 guests, and Tsuki-no-Ma + Hana-no-Ma for 26 guests (room fees are 5,500 yen / 11,000 yen for 2 hours).
